import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Click the filter button using accessibility tree-centric selectors
    # The button is in a group that contains the textbox
    filter_group = page.get_by_role("group").filter(has=page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search or filter results..."))
    filter_button = filter_group.get_by_role("button")
    await filter_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the filter dropdown to appear
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # Select 'Label' filter option
    label_option = page.get_by_text("Label", exact=True)
    await label_option.click()
    await asyncio.sleep(1)
    
    # Select 'No Label' option
    no_label_option = page.get_by_text("No Label", exact=True)
    await no_label_option.click()
    
    # Wait for the page to update with filtered issues
    await asyncio.sleep(5)
    
    # Make API call to fetch opened issues with no labels
    api_url = "http://172.26.116.102:8080/api/v4/projects/root%2Fmetaseq/issues?state=opened&labels="
    response = await page.request.get(api_url)
    response_body = await response.text()
    
    # Print the API response exactly as received
    print(response_body)
    
    # Return the response body for terminate_with_result
    return response_body
